input_template:
Task brief and acceptance criteria: ...
Explicit user model choice, or none: ...
Caller-defined small/standard/frontier mapping to available models and capabilities: ...
Relevant code, affected boundaries, and impact evidence: ...
Contract and security effects: ...
Ambiguities, unknowns, and difficult reasoning: ...

questions.name: tier
questions.instructions: Choose a tier using the caller-defined mapping to available model capabilities and the task's reasoning needs. Require the brief, acceptance criteria, impact evidence, and ambiguity notes. Missing mapping or required evidence, conflicting evidence, or uncertain impact requires insufficient_context; the caller must use the frontier fallback. Established reasoning needs beyond cheaper capabilities or contract or security changes require frontier. A small local edit can require difficult reasoning; file or line counts do not establish adequacy. An explicit user model choice takes precedence and this result must never replace it. If the choice cannot be mapped or respected, use insufficient_context for coordinator handling.

choices.description: Positive evidence shows the mapped small model can handle the routine task with no contract or security effects.
Positive evidence shows the mapped standard model can handle the bounded reasoning while preserving contracts and security boundaries.
Established complex reasoning or contract or security changes require the strongest tier.
Missing or conflicting evidence prevents establishing tier adequacy; use the frontier fallback.
